scope: Bounded read-only M13 Calendar replacement investigation in the current main working tree; selection changes are uncommitted and accepted-direction work.
status: Replacement seam recommended. Date parser and delivery prerequisites identified. No Calendar implementation or native component acceptance claimed.
changes: This JSON is the only repository file written by this investigation. No source, generated output, package, status, licensed reference source, or upstream service was changed.

approvedContract.value: ISO string | {start: ISO string, end?: ISO string} | undefined
approvedContract.timeZone: Explicit IANA zone or browser local zone
approvedContract.events: acme-input for provisional range; acme-change for committed value
approvedContract.form: One scalar or JSON range; only a complete valid range satisfies required

findings.finding: toDate matches only the leading YYYY-MM-DD and drops timestamp offsets/time. Invalid day/month fields normalize through native Date. Formatting hard-codes en-US; date arithmetic uses browser-local fields.

Public value/end/single/static and time strings are the retired shape. Calendar does not extend AcmeFormElement; selected value is plain Lit property state while internal navigation uses atomState. showTimeInput does not turn date value into a timestamp.

Global click/resize/scroll handlers, manual geometry, custom Tab wrapping and popup focus restoration duplicate existing overlay controllers. aria-modal=true on a Popover does not itself make the page modal.
Day picks mutate value/end directly; only commit dispatches acme-change with the old multi-field payload. Timezone is returned as a label rather than used in arithmetic.
Month stepping through native Date can overflow Jan 31 into March. Keyboard mapping ignores RTL; Home/End assume Sunday; header navigation can leave the roving focused day outside the displayed grid.

Five happy-dom tests assert the retired interface and selected markup. They do not verify native forms, actual modal focus containment, DST, offset parsing, RTL, lifecycle cleanup, source/compiled parity or renderer child identity. Tests were read, not rerun in this investigation.

Current examples use old compact/stacked/presetIndex/end/allowClear/static/pinnedTimezone interfaces. Replace them with approved single/range, time/date-only, inline/popover, bounds, presets, Field and form flows.
Its date-only meaning is UTC midnight. Calendar date-only values are civil dates. Do not reuse relativeInstant as the Calendar parser. Both timestamp consumers need the corrected upstream parser.

parserPrerequisite.comparison: Installed src/string.ts and fetched main src/string.ts are byte-identical.

defects.location: src/string.ts parseAbsolute, day check and numeric offset calculation
defects.finding: The minute offset is always added to signed hours, so negative fractional offsets and -00:mm change the instant incorrectly.
Minimum day is zero; invalid civil date-time input is accepted or normalized. parseDate already uses minimum one.

parserPrerequisite.recommendation: No fixed latest stable release exists in the checked registry; latest and main both retain the defects. Use an exact-version Bun dependency patch at the package parser, including affected shipped dist/private/string.mjs, string.js and string.cjs paths, with source kept consistent. Compute offset sign from the original +/- token so -00:mm works; require day >= 1 in all three date-time parsers. This is an upstream-package correction, not a second Calendar parser.
regressionCases: UTC Z and whole-hour negative offsets
month end, leap February and out-of-range day/month
zoned offset validation including zero-hour fractional signs
RelativeTime offset instant through its public helper

delivery.observed: scripts/build.ts:77-85 transpiles split ESM and preserves external imports; dist/shared/relative-time.js currently imports @internationalized/date. CDN and complete bundles use Bun.build and capture installed code. scripts/package.ts drops patchedDependencies from production manifests and stages only declared files.
delivery.risk: A repo-local Bun patch alone fixes current bundled output but does not ensure fresh npm/Bun split-ESM consumers run corrected date code.
delivery.recommendation: Build one private versioned ESM dependency bundle from the patched date package and route all house runtime date imports through that local artifact before CDN/full-bundle generation. Keep the same upstream implementation, exact version, source hash, patch and Apache license/notice provenance. Include the private artifact in dist; do not require consumer patch configuration, postinstall mutation or a registry fork. Prevent mixed raw/patched house runtime imports. Public Calendar values remain ISO strings, so consumers need not share date-class identity.
acceptance: Inspect packed split ESM and metafiles for the private corrected runtime path and absence of escaping bare date-runtime imports.
In clean temporary npm and Bun consumer directories, install only the staged package without repository patches; run exact parser counterexamples through public RelativeTime/Calendar behavior.
Run the same probes against selective CDN graph, normal/minified bundles and standalone bundle.
Verify one house date-runtime graph, retained required license/notice files, and source-to-compiled behavior parity.
delivery.status: Recommendation only; no dependency patch, install, build change or publication performed.

replacementSeam.owner: AcmeCalendar extends the existing form-element base and owns one NativeFormController<CalendarValue>. Per-instance atomState holds navigation, open state and raw editor text; createAtom derives formatting, grid cells and validity. Do not maintain separate writable value/end/timezone mirrors of the same selection.
replacementSeam.dateModule: Add a small pure internal Calendar-value module for ISO shape validation, package-backed conversion/comparison, range normalization and grid generation. It consumes the corrected shared date dependency seam; native Date is only an explicit formatting bridge, never Calendar arithmetic.
replacementSeam.values: showTimeInput=false accepts date-only ISO and preserves that civil date across zones. showTimeInput=true accepts offset-bearing ISO timestamps and preserves the instant when timeZone changes. Public partial ranges remain representable. Reject impossible input rather than normalizing it silently; do not interpret a bare date as a timestamp.
replacementSeam.timeEditing: Use native time editors with machine-readable HH:mm[:ss] values; convert with parseTime/toCalendarDateTime/toZoned. Avoid hand-written AM/PM arithmetic. If numeric fields need localized input, reuse the approved Number Input/NumberParser responsibilities; never feed an entire date string through NumberParser.
replacementSeam.dst: Resolve local time explicitly: reject nonexistent times with a visible validation error; for a repeated local time prefer an existing valid selected offset, otherwise choose the package earlier occurrence and display the resulting offset. This is a recommended documented engineering policy, not a new user vote. Include both occurrences and gap tests.
replacementSeam.formAndField: One root owns the native form name/value and registers once with Field. Reuse FieldControl/FieldAssociation and SemanticAttributes for host name, help/error and activation. Choose a connected visible native focus target for each presentation; inline mode cannot leave reportValidity anchored to a hidden trigger. Submit scalar/JSON without child duplicate successful controls; reset/restoration/programmatic writes remain silent.
replacementSeam.events: Keep valid provisional range edits in the canonical public value and emit acme-input. Commit emits one acme-change with the approved scalar/range shape only when valid and complete. Raw invalid editor text is separate draft text, not a fake ISO value. Preserve source selection on close/reopen; do not invent cancellation rollback or emit commit just because focus moves. Range/time editors retain an explicit Apply action; date-only single pick may commit directly.
replacementSeam.overlay: Reuse OverlayPresence, OverlayPlacement and SpringValue/readMotionSpring. The saved source contract requires contained popup focus. Prefer a root-owned anchored native dialog with modal presence for the popover presentation, using Floating UI geometry and the assigned Calendar shadow5; never claim aria-modal on a plain Popover supplies modality. Inline presentation shares date content but has no modal lifetime or focus trap. Confirm this native mechanism in browser before implementation acceptance.
replacementSeam.trigger: Follow the newly verified selection seam: root-owned native button with noninteractive trigger content slot; preserve supplied node identity. Keep footer independent and account for its focusable descendants through native dialog containment. No cloning, light-DOM movement, private button internals or author callback render engine.
replacementSeam.keyboard: Real button cells and one grid Tab stop. Day arrows, vertical week movement, source Shift+arrow week jumps, PageUp/Down months, Shift+PageUp/Down years, locale week Home/End, RTL horizontal reversal, Enter/Space selection. Clamp day to destination month and selected bounds. Visible month changes must preserve a reachable roving target.
replacementSeam.presets: Presets remain data supplied to Calendar and resolved with package date arithmetic in the effective zone. Use a single documented readonly array shape; remove object-record/presetIndex/relative native-Date aliases. Preserve useful fixed/relative presets only through one shape confirmed against the approved capability, without application data fetching.
replacementSeam.replacement: Remove old single/end/static/allowClear/pinnedTimezone/compact/stacked/horizontalLayout/popoverAlignment/presetIndex shapes where superseded by F08. Update consumer docs/tests/metadata together. All style declarations come from styles and the existing producers; never hand-edit generated style modules.

nativeAcceptanceMatrix.oracle: Trigger/footer slotted nodes retain identity across edits, reorder, removal, reconnect and parent updates; no node copying or reparenting.
Enter/Space trigger opens; selected/current/bounded day receives focus; Tab/Shift+Tab includes footer and stays contained only in popup mode.
Escape/outside/top overlay closes exactly the intended surface; focus returns only when appropriate and never steals it from an outside target.
Inline mode remains visible, has one grid Tab stop, does not trap page focus and uses a visible form validation anchor.
One scalar/JSON successful form value; required empty and incomplete range invalid; disabled fieldset/Field excludes submission; reset/default/restoration work.
Standalone and Field labels/help/errors name the actual trigger/grid/editor; current, selected and provisional days differ; full dates and month changes are announced.
Day/week/month/year navigation, Jan31->Feb28, leap day, locale week Home/End, bounds and no empty roving target after header navigation.
LTR and RTL arrows, visual weekday order and focus order agree. Locale/direction changes update open and closed controls.
Date-only YYYY-MM-DD remains the same civil date; offset timestamps preserve exact instants through effective-zone changes.
Negative fractional/zero-hour offsets and day-zero counterexamples pass corrected dependency and compiled consumer paths.
Spring gap rejects nonexistent local time; fall overlap preserves/chooses documented offset; range bounds compare instants when time is enabled.
Typing invalid/partial text and IME never normalizes mid-entry or commits invalid dates; clear/preset/day/time actions emit exact input/change sequence; programmatic writes silent.
Range start-only, reversed click order, same-day range, edited endpoints, required incomplete range, Apply, reopen and no accidental commit on Escape.
Min/max changes, malformed public values, invalid zones, showTimeInput/mode changes and presets handle explicit normalization/validation rules without stale value shape.
Scroll/resize/zoom/viewport-edge placement, rapid reopen, removal/adoption and nesting release observers, scroll locks and obsolete async geometry.
Reduced-motion change mid-animation, forced colors, both themes, narrow layout and touch-sized actual target geometry remain usable.
Staged split ESM, selective CDN and complete/standalone bundles all execute corrected date behavior without consumer patch setup.
Every replaced single/range/date-only/time/inline/preset/bounds/Field example completes its stated action; no stale interface remains.
